visual_description: The image displays a login page for the U.S. Department of Education’s Education Stabilization Fund (ESF), specifically for grantees. A central box titled “Grantee Log In” instructs users to log in via Login.gov or USAAccess PIV card, with two buttons: “Cancel” and “Login,” the latter highlighted by a red rectangle. Below are three FAQ-style help sections addressing password resets, email address discrepancies, and multiple email access — each directing users to contact either the Login.gov help center or the ESF Reporting Helpdesk. The top right corner shows a green “Grantee Login” button with an arrow icon. No charts, tables, axes, or numerical data are present.
